snippet.title: Antiquity Jones - RZX Playback
snippet.description:
Antiquity Jones
2012 - Paul Jenkinson (UK)
ZX-Spectrum 48K/128K - Arcade Game: Platform

Recorded by Pavel Plíva (with rollback)

More info here: https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/27506/ZX-Spectrum/Antiquity_Jones

We are most grateful to the late Daren Pearcy for all his work in popularising the RZX format. Without his work this project would not have been possible.
